compression_algorithms.description: Complete list of lossless compression algorithms supported by tar and common utilities

characteristics.special_feature: Instant single-file extraction without decompressing entire archive

characteristics.use_case: Live systems, boot images, real-time logs

recommended_algorithm_function.name: get_recommended_algorithm
recommended_algorithm_function.description: Logic for automatic algorithm recommendation based on goals and resources

decision_tree.parameters: -3 to -6 (default -3 or higher for better ratio)
decision_tree.rationale: Modern standard, excellent speed/ratio balance, used by Arch Linux and Ubuntu
Extremely fast decompression, suitable for live operations

principles: Redundancy Analysis: Identify patterns, sequences, or repeated symbols in data
Efficient Encoding: Replace repeated data with shorter representations (frequency tables or dictionaries)
Reversibility: Process is bidirectional; decompressed file is identical bit-for-bit to original

main_algorithms_theory.name: Huffman Coding
main_algorithms_theory.description: Assigns shorter binary codes to more frequent elements, longer codes to rare ones

main_algorithms_theory.name: LZ Family (Lempel-Ziv)
main_algorithms_theory.description: Replace repeated sequences with references to earlier occurrences in data stream

main_algorithms_theory.name: Run-Length Encoding (RLE)
main_algorithms_theory.description: Simplifies consecutive identical data by counting repetitions (e.g., 8W instead of WWWWWWWW)

main_algorithms_theory.name: Arithmetic Coding
main_algorithms_theory.description: Converts entire message into a single real number between 0 and 1, optimizing space based on symbol probabilities

main_algorithms_theory.name: Burrows-Wheeler Transform (BWT)
main_algorithms_theory.description: Rearranges data to group similar characters, preparing stream for more effective compression

important_notes: Lossless compression algorithms cannot guarantee that ALL input data will decrease in size
Some data types (e.g., already compressed files like JPEG, MP3) may increase in size
Compression ratio varies by data type and content patterns
Always test with representative data before large-scale deployment

security_considerations.integrity_verification: SHA-256 hash verification recommended for backup archives
security_considerations.encryption_compatibility: All lossless formats support post-compression encryption (Argon2id + XSalsa20-Poly1305)
security_considerations.recommended_workflow: tar -> zstd -> encrypt (no intermediate files, streaming pipeline)
